verdict.rationale: Ollama's homepage claims "dedicated capacity so throughput holds up when you are running several agents at once" (ollama-docs-4), and the pricing page lists running multiple models concurrently (ollama-docs-17). Both are single marketing lines: they don't explain how capacity is reserved, which plans or deployments (local vs. Cloud) it covers, or how much throughput is sustained. Missing for 10: technical documentation of the capacity-reservation mechanism and concurrency limits, clarity on whether it applies locally or only to Cloud, and independent or hands-on benchmarks showing steady throughput under concurrent sessions.
